## Context / Problem
13 MB of research artefacts live under `docs/experiments/`; `docs/calibration/` holds 4 notes plus `plan_v5_rescore.py`. Living under `docs/` makes them docs-tooling link-check targets and is the ONLY reason CodeQL skips them. Packaging is non-shipping: wheel `packages = ["src/rebar"]` (`pyproject.toml:363-367`), sdist `include` (`:391`), no `MANIFEST.in`. `scripts/check_docs_index.py` link-checks `docs` recursively (`:103`), so after the move it stops seeing the tree. Cites verified on `aa37a738570`.

## Approach
`git mv docs/experiments evals && git mv docs/calibration evals/calibration` (history preserved), then repoint every live reference OUTSIDE the moved tree.

**The moved tree's own contents are frozen as authored.** 61 files / 157 lines inside the two trees embed the literal old paths — harness scripts, run artefacts, eval-spec fixtures, notes. Those strings record what was actually executed, so rewriting them would falsify the research record, as for `docs/archive/`. `evals/` is excluded from the AC2 grep.

**The worklist is the Testing grep plus the relative-link grep below, not a hand-kept list** — successive hand enumerations each missed live references, so AC2 and AC7 enforce the target instead.

- **`rebar.toml`** `:51` (a `docs/calibration/completion_floor.md` comment), `:216` (comment) and `:220` (`[llm.evals] corpus_root`, which flips to `"evals"`).
- **`.gitignore`** `:19`, `:122` (a comment naming `replay/corpus-*.manifest.json`) and `:123`.
- **CodeQL — load-bearing.** `codeql-config.yml`'s whole ignore list is `docs/**` (`:8-9`), so the tree is excluded ONLY by living under `docs/`. A top-level `evals/` leaves that umbrella and CodeQL would scan the 65 research `.py` files, so `evals/**` must be added under `paths-ignore` HERE.
- **Live docs under `docs/`**: `architecture.md:312`, `plan-review-gate.md:126,142,198,281,473,1537,1562,1804`, `remediation-implementation-plan.md:180,188,306`, `review-kernel.md:35`. `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md:8` is GENERATED from `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_A1.md:10`; repoint the reviewer source and regenerate rather than editing the guide.
- **A SECOND axis the grep cannot see: relative markdown links.** `docs/*.md` links in as `](experiments/...)`/`](calibration/...)` with no `docs/` prefix, so AC2 can print nothing while every link still points at vacated paths and `check_docs_index.py`'s link check breaks. Six lines: `README.md:129,141` (7 links), `architecture.md:310,312`, `llm-framework.md:80,81` — each becomes `](../evals/...)`. Find with `git grep -n '](experiments/\|](calibration/' -- 'docs/*.md'`; AC7 enforces it.
- **Source/packaged data**: `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_A1.md:10` ("a path under `evals/` (formerly `docs/experiments/`)"); `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` `_comment`s at `:4,92,112,158,189,197,205`; `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_advisory.py:164` and `det_operator_attested.py:11`; `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py:5` and `legacy_v4_baseline.py:2-6`; `src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py` (the `[llm.evals]` comment); the six eval-spec comments plus `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/README.plan-review.md:67`; `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py:45`, `scripts/check_dco_identity.py:30`, `scripts/calibrate_completion_floor.py:9`.
- **Carry no such string** (verified, dropped from the worklist): `src/rebar/grounding/resolve.py`, `src/rebar/llm/structured.py`, `tests/unit/gold_set_completion.py`.
- **Tests — 21 files, 34 hits in THREE categories, not one.** (a) REPOINT: the harness path loaders (`test_impact_model_versioning.py` has TWO, `:41` and `:146`; `test_transition_force_flag_24f7.py` has four hits, `:148,149,150,153`), plus `test_canonical.py:83` and `test_code_review_criteria_routing.py:140`, the latter asserting `superseded_by == "docs/experiments/code-review-threshold-calibration-code-v5.md"` and moving in step with `criteria_routing.json:4,158`. (b) COUPLED REPOINT — a fixture that must move with its script's allowlist, or the test breaks: `scripts/check_dco_identity.py:30` `EXCLUDED_PREFIXES` with `test_check_dco_identity.py:110`, and `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py:45` with `test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py:169,210`. (c) FREEZE — the old string is the point, so repointing it would break the test: `test_removed_cli_verbs_heldout.py:44` and `test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py:25` hold `_HISTORY_PREFIXES` that scan git HISTORY, where `docs/experiments/` paths still exist in old commits — ADD `evals/`, keep the old prefix; `tests/scripts/test_classify_gerrit_verify_change.py:57,58` are synthetic classifier INPUTS, not references to the tree. Those three files stay in-grep, so AC2 excludes them by name.
- **Sequencing on `d279` (`disgusted-fretful-hare`, closed).** It added `tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py::test_no_hard_coded_roots`, which asserts `corpus.py` is the SOLE `docs/experiments` match under `src/rebar/llm/evals` (its AC1). Repointing `corpus.py:5` empties that grep and fails the assertion, so this change rewrites that module for the moved tree — the assertion AND its three old-path literals at `:5`, `:96`, `:102`; AC2 does not exclude `tests/unit/evals`. Also new in `d279`: `test_plan_replay_cli_paths.py:4` and `config_readers.py` above.
- `evals/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py` keeps importing `rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay.legacy_v4_baseline` (research-to-src); `legacy_v4_baseline.py` stays the v4 formula's importable home because `evals/` is not on `sys.path`.

## Scope
The moved trees; `rebar.toml`; `.gitignore`; `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml`; the 3 scripts, the source/packaged-data files, the live docs, and the 20 test files enumerated above. Parent epic `e47b` AC2 carries the identical carve-outs, so leaf and parent agree. Deliberately NOT repointed: the moved tree's own 157 internal references (frozen as authored, above), `docs/adr/` (6 refs), `docs/archive/`, `docs/research/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `tests/fixtures/`, and generated `.test_durations`. AC2's grep excludes exactly that set.

## Testing
`python scripts/check_docs_index.py`; `python scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`; `python evals/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py --root=.`; `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide` (the guide is GENERATED and must not be hand-edited); then `make verify`. Edge: `python -m build --wheel && unzip -l dist/*.whl | grep -c 'evals/'` prints `0`, sdist likewise; `git log --follow evals/plan-review-gate/replay/ledger.jsonl` shows pre-move history.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `docs/experiments` and `docs/calibration` are absent, and `evals/` contains exactly the union of the former `docs/experiments/**` and `docs/calibration/**` files — same total file count as the two trees had before the move, with `docs/calibration/**` now under `evals/calibration/**`.
- [ ] `git grep -n 'docs/experiments\|docs/calibration' -- . ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/archive' ':!docs/research' ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!tests/fixtures' ':!.test_durations' ':!evals' ':!tests/interfaces/contracts/test_removed_cli_verbs_heldout.py' ':!tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py' ':!tests/scripts/test_classify_gerrit_verify_change.py'` prints nothing — the three named files are the category-(c) freezes above.
- [ ] The wheel contains no `evals/` entry, and the sdist contains no `evals/` entry.
- [ ] `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml` lists `evals/**` under `paths-ignore`.
- [ ] `git diff -U0 -- docs/README.md` has exactly two hunks (lines 129 and 141).
- [ ] `python scripts/check_docs_index.py` exits 0, proving no `docs/*.md` relative link still points into the vacated trees.
- [ ] `tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py::test_no_hard_coded_roots` passes against the moved tree, and that module carries no `docs/experiments` literal.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
